summary: Adlai Nortye Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on October 15, 2026, disclosing clinical trial collaboration and supply agreements (CTCSAs) with Eli Lilly and Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany for cetuximab (ERBITUX). The agreements support the company's ongoing global Phase I trial evaluating AN4035, a first-in-class pan-RAS(ON) inhibitor-based ADC, as monotherapy and in combination with cetuximab in CEACAM5-enriched RAS-addicted solid tumors. Adlai Nortye sponsors the trial; Lilly supplies cetuximab at no cost for U.S. sites, Merck KGaA for Australia and China sites. This is a routine R&D collaboration, not a special situation.
